vaultRef.label: Vault ref
vaultRef.explain: How Nerya remembers your API key safely. The key itself is encrypted in the local vault; the config only keeps a vault:// address pointing at it. Just paste the key in plain text when setting up, Nerya converts it for you.

fetchModels.label: Fetch models
fetchModels.explain: Asks the provider for the list of models your key can use. Run this after pasting a key, then tick the models you want Nerya to work with.

tier.label: Model tier
tier.explain: A slot that decides which model handles which kind of work. Heavy analysis uses the High tier, everyday replies Medium, quick lookups Low, and Intent recognizes what a message is asking for. One model can fill several tiers.

apiShape.label: API shape
apiShape.explain: The dialect the provider's API speaks. Most providers are OpenAI-compatible; Anthropic has its own. Leave it on Auto-detect unless the connection test fails.

webhook.label: Webhook
webhook.explain: A URL the platform calls to push messages to Nerya in real time. The alternative is polling, where Nerya checks for new messages every few seconds.

polling.label: Polling
polling.explain: Nerya periodically asks the platform for new messages instead of waiting to be pushed. Works everywhere and needs no public URL, at the cost of a little extra quota.

capabilityGate.label: Capability gate
capabilityGate.explain: A hard on/off switch for an entire feature area (trading, browsing, network). When off, that feature stays blocked no matter how complete the rest of the setup is.

tunnel.label: Tunnel
tunnel.explain: A secure bridge that makes your local Nerya reachable from the internet, so chat platforms can deliver messages to it.
